blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multi-tumor segmentation is important for early cancer detection and allows radiologists to visualize, verify, and understand AI predictions. However, tumor segmentation masks are expensive, time-consuming, and unavailable for many tumor types in public data. Instead, hospitals have vast, readily available data that can guide segmentation: radiology reports, longitudinal images, and multi-phase images. We use this readily available data to substitute for tumor masks in training AI for tumor segmentation. To this end, we propose a new architecture, RT-Super. It has a teacher network, which analyzes the patient’s longitudinal images and reports to create high-quality tumor masks. These masks train a student network, which sees a single image and no report. At inference, when longitudinal images and reports are unavailable, we use the student. RT-Super uses a new CNN-Transformer architecture and novel Consistency Losses that exploit tumor location consistency across longitudinal images. We train RT-Super to segment esophagus, uterus and spleen tumors, which have few or no public masks. Even without training masks, RT-Super can segment these tumors and surpass public AI models. Overall, we demonstrate that learning from longitudinal images, multi-phase images, and reports can overcome mask scarcity and advance multi-cancer detection and segmentation. Code: https://github.com/MrGiovanni/RT-Super .
blocks.zh: 多肿瘤分解对于早期的癌症检测很重要,使放射科医生能够直观,验证,理解AI预测. 然而,在公共数据中,肿瘤分解口罩昂贵、耗时,而且许多类型的肿瘤无法使用。 相反,医院拥有大量现成的数据,可以指导分解:放射学报告、纵向图像和多相图像。 我们用这个现成的数据来代替肿瘤口罩 来训练肿瘤分解的AI 为此,我们提出一个新的架构,RT-Super. 它有一个教师网络,分析患者的纵向图像和报告,以创造高质量的肿瘤口罩. 这些面具训练一个学生网络,它看到一个单一的形象,没有报道. 推论,当没有纵向图像和报告时,我们使用学生。 RT-Super使用新的CNN-Transformer架构和小说"一致性丧失"(Consistency Losses),利用了纵向图像的肿瘤位置一致性. 我们训练RT-Super来分解食道,子宫和脾脏肿瘤,它们很少或没有公共面具. 即使没有训练口罩,RT-Super也能分解这些肿瘤并超越公共AI模型. 总体而言,我们表明,从纵向图像、多相图像和报告中学习,可以克服遮掩的稀缺性,推进多癌症检测和分化。 代码:https://github.com/MrGiovanni/RT-Super 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Early detection of multiple cancer types can greatly improve patient survival [ 4 , 6 , 17 ] , but multi-tumor segmentation is challenging: tumor segmentation masks are expensive and time-consuming to create [ 11 ] , mostly unavailable in hospitals, and public datasets offer masks for only a few tumor types. For example, public computed tomography (CT) datasets and segmentation models mainly cover tumors in the lungs, liver, pancreas, kidneys, and colon [ 14 , 20 , 21 ] .
blocks.zh: 早期检测多种癌症类型可以大大改善患者生存[4,6,17],但多肿瘤分化具有挑战性:肿瘤分化口罩造型昂贵且耗时[11],大部分医院没有,公共数据集只能为少数类型的肿瘤提供口罩. 例如,公共计算成像数据集和分块模型主要覆盖肺、肝、胰腺、肾和结肠的肿瘤[14、20、21]。

blocks.en: While tumor masks are scarce, hospitals routinely collect rich alternative data that can guide tumor segmentation: (1) Longitudinal images : past and future scans of the same patient, where tumors that were small and subtle in past scans may become larger and clearer in future scans; (2) Multi-phase images : CT scans with different contrast phases, where intravenous contrast can improve tumor visibility; and (3) Radiology reports : expert-written text often describing tumor size, location, and count. These data sources are readily available in hospitals and can effectively substitute for or augment scarce tumor masks. Thus, we ask: can AI architectures and training methods exploit reports, longitudinal images, and multi-phase images to learn tumor segmentation with fewer or no tumor masks?
blocks.zh: 虽然肿瘤口罩很少,但医院通常收集丰富的替代数据,以指导肿瘤的分解: (1)纵向图像:同一患者的过去和未来扫描,过去扫描中小而微妙的肿瘤在将来扫描中可能变大和变清晰; (2)多相图像: 具有不同对比阶段的CT扫描,其中静脉对比可以提高肿瘤的可见度;以及 (3)放射学报告:专家撰写的文本经常描述肿瘤大小,位置,和计数. 这些数据来源很容易在医院获得,能够有效替代或增强稀缺的肿瘤口罩。 因此,我们问:人工智能的架构和培训方法是否能够利用报告、纵向图像和多相图像来学习肿瘤分化,同时少用或不用肿瘤口罩?

blocks.en: We hypothesize that leveraging longitudinal images, multi-phase images, and radiology reports in training enables AI to segment multiple tumor types without abundant segmentation masks and improves inference performance with only a single image and no report. This hypothesis stems from our observation that, when asked to segment tumors, radiologists often request all available patient images across time, multi-phase images, and all their reports [ 18 ] . By looking at future scans or contrast-enhanced scans, radiologists can better find and segment tumors that are small or barely visible in previous or non-contrast scans.
blocks.zh: 我们假设,利用纵向图像、多相图像和放射学报告在训练中,AI能够分解多种肿瘤类型,而不带丰富的分解口罩,并用单一的图像和无报告改善推论性能。 这个假说来源于我们的观察,当被要求分解肿瘤时,放射学家常常会要求所有可获取的患者图像跨时间,多相图像,以及他们的所有报告[18]. 通过观察未来的扫描或对比增强的扫描,放射学家可以更好地发现和分块肿瘤,这些肿瘤在之前的或非连续的扫描中是小的或几乎不可见的.

blocks.en: Inspired by this, we propose the RT-Super architecture (Report & Time Supervision). During training, a teacher network receives as input longitudinal and multi-phase images and all their reports. By exploring this comprehensive information, the teacher can create higher-quality tumor masks. In the absence of ground-truth tumor masks, the masks made by the teacher are used to train a student network, which only receives one image and no report. Therefore, the student can be used at inference when longitudinal/multi-phase images and reports are unavailable 1 1 1 A first diagnostic image often has no prior images; reports are always assumed missing, as AI does not need to detect tumors already detected and described in reports. . While the student learns from the teacher masks, the teacher learns from Report Supervision losses [ 1 ] and a new Consistency Loss. The new loss exploits consistencies across longitudinal images, so that images where tumors are larger help the teacher segment images where tumors are smaller. For efficiency, the student is part of the teacher network (self-distillation). With RT-Super, we demonstrate that learning from reports, longitudinal images, and multi-phase images improves tumor segmentation even when only a single image and no report are available at inference.
blocks.zh: 受此启发,我们提出RT-Super架构(报告和时间监督). 在培训期间,教师网络接收纵向和多阶段图像及其所有报告。 通过探索这种综合信息,老师可以创造出质量更高的肿瘤口罩. 在没有地面真人肿瘤口罩的情况下,老师制作的口罩被用来训练学生网络,学生网络只收到一个图像,没有报告. 因此,当纵向/多相图像和报告无法获得时,学生可以被推断为 " 第一诊断图像 " 往往没有以前的图像;报告总是被假定缺失,因为AI不需要检测报告中已经检测和描述的肿瘤。 学生学习师口罩的同时,教师学习报告监督损失[1]和新的一致性损失. 新的损失利用了纵向图像的构成,因此肿瘤较大的图像有助于肿瘤较小的教师部分图像。 为提高效率,该学生是教师网络(自我消化)的一部分。 通过RT-Super,我们证明,从报告、纵向图像和多相图像中学习可以改善肿瘤的分化,即使只有单一的图像和没有报告可以推断。

blocks.en: To train RT-Super, we used a large-scale dataset, with 34,152 CT scans. This dataset focuses on esophagus, spleen and uterus tumors, because these tumor types have scarce public tumor masks (fewer than 60 for uterus and esophagus [ 8 ] , none for spleen). Our dataset exemplifies what is readily available in hospitals: reports, longitudinal images, and multi-phase images, but no masks. Here, we train both with many reports and no tumor mask, and with many reports and few tumor masks (767, created by our collaborating radiologists). In tumor detection, RT-Super substantially surpassed public AI models such as Google’s MedGemma [ 23 ] , Stanford’s Merlin [ 5 ] , and Universal Lesion Segmentation (ULS) [ 13 ] (Tab. 1 ). It also surpassed alternative tumor segmentation methods trained on our dataset, such as CLIP [ 5 , 22 ] , multi-task learning (MTL) [ 26 ] , and self-supervised learning (Models Genesis) [ 27 ] (Tab. 1 ). Our main contributions are: 1. RT-Super, an architecture that learns multi-tumor segmentation with fewer or no masks. It learns from radiology reports, longitudinal images, and multi-phase images. It improves performance even with a single image and no report at inference (Tab. 1 , 2 ). 2. We created the Consistency Loss, which exploits the consistency across longitudinal and multi-phase images to improve tumor segmentation. 3. We release RT-Super that largely surpassed public AI models in the detection and segmentation of esophagus, spleen, and uterus tumors (Tab. 1 , 2 ).
blocks.zh: 为了训练RT-Super,我们使用了一个大规模的数据集,有34,152个CT扫描. 本数据集主要关注食道,脾脏和子宫肿瘤,因为这些类型的肿瘤具有稀缺的公共肿瘤口罩(子宫和食道的腹腔大于60个[8],脾脏没有). 我们的数据集说明了医院中现成的情况:报告、纵向图像和多阶段图像,但没有面具。 在这里,我们用许多报告和没有肿瘤面具来训练,用许多报告和很少的肿瘤面具(767年,由我们的合作放射学家创造). 在肿瘤检测中,RT-Super大大超越了Google的MedGemma[23],斯坦福的Merlin[5],和Universal Lesion分片(ULS)[13](第1段)等公共AI模型. 它还超越了我们数据集培训的替代肿瘤分解方法,如CLIP[5,22],多任务学习[MTL][26],以及自我监督的学习(Models Egenesis)[27](第1段)。 我们的主要贡献是: 1. RT-Super,一种学习多图层分解的架构,口罩较少或没有口罩. 它学习放射学报告,纵向图像,以及多相图像. 它即使以单一的图像改善性能,也没有报告推论(第1,2段)。 2. 我们创造了一致性损失,利用纵向和多相图像的一致性,改善肿瘤分化。 3. 在食道、脾脏和子宫肿瘤的检测和分化方面,我们释放的RT-Super基本上超过了公共AI模型(第1、2段)。

blocks.en: RT-Super, an architecture that learns multi-tumor segmentation with fewer or no masks. It learns from radiology reports, longitudinal images, and multi-phase images. It improves performance even with a single image and no report at inference (Tab. 1 , 2 ).
blocks.zh: RT-Super),一种以更少或没有口罩的方式学习多图层分割的建筑. 它学习放射学报告,纵向图像,以及多相图像. 它即使以单一的图像改善性能,也没有报告推论(第1,2段)。

blocks.en: We created the Consistency Loss, which exploits the consistency across longitudinal and multi-phase images to improve tumor segmentation.
blocks.zh: 我们创造了一致性损失,利用纵向和多相图像的一致性来改善肿瘤分化。

blocks.en: We release RT-Super that largely surpassed public AI models in the detection and segmentation of esophagus, spleen, and uterus tumors (Tab. 1 , 2 ).
blocks.zh: 我们释放的RT-Super在食道、脾脏和子宫肿瘤的检测和分化方面基本上超过了公共AI模型(第1,2段)。

blocks.en: Related work. Previous work explored synthetic tumors [ 8 , 15 ] and radiology reports, readily available in hospitals, for learning tumor segmentation. Multi-task learning strategies extract classification labels (e.g., tumor presence or absence) from radiology reports. These labels train the AI model for classification, while the available tumor masks train it for segmentation [ 26 ] . Vision-language foundation models (VLMs) were trained on reports with contrastive losses (e.g., CLIP [ 22 ] ), and fine-tuned for segmentation with masks [ 5 ] . These strategies used reports to learn auxiliary tasks (classification or CLIP). Instead, Report Supervision [ 1 ] used reports to directly supervise segmentation, introducing loss functions that make segmented tumors match the tumor count, sizes, and locations described in reports. This approach substantially improved performance. However, prior work has not used longitudinal and multi-phase CT scans as an additional source of information to further substitute for masks in learning tumor segmentation.
blocks.zh: 相关工作. 以前的工作探索了合成肿瘤[8,15]和放射学报告,这些报告在医院很容易获得,用于学习肿瘤分解。 多任务学习策略从放射学报告中提取分类标签(如肿瘤存在与否). 这些标签对AI模型进行分类训练,而现有的肿瘤口罩对它进行分化训练[26]. 愿景语基础模型(VLMs)接受了关于具有对比性损失的报告(如CLIP[22])的培训,并对带口罩的分割进行了微调[5]. 这些战略利用报告学习辅助任务(分类或CLIP). 相反,报告监督[1]使用报告直接监督分块,引入了损失功能,使分块肿瘤与报告所述的肿瘤计数、大小和位置相符。 这种办法大大提高了业绩。 然而,先前的工作并未使用纵向和多相CT扫描作为补充信息来源,在学习肿瘤分解时进一步替代口罩.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of RT-Super. (a) Multi-image training. RT-Super is a teacher-student framework. For a patient with multiple scans (e.g., different time points or contrast phases), we run one teacher-student instance (shared weights) per scan. Each student processes one scan independently. The teachers exchange information via inter-image cross-attention and are trained with an additional Consistency Loss across scans. (b) Teacher-student distillation. The teacher leverages information from multiple images and from reports to create high-quality tumor segmentation masks. The student sees one image only, but it is trained with the high-quality masks created by the teacher. At inference, when multiple images and reports are often not available, we use only the student. (c) Report-aware transformer. The teacher has a transformer that receives information from longitudinal images and reports via cross-attention. It uses this information to create convolutional kernels, which refine features from the student to create an improved, report- and longitudinal-aware tumor mask. As the teacher creates this mask by refining the student’s features, the student is part of the teacher.
blocks.zh: 图1:RT-Super概览. (a) 多形象培训。 RT-Super是一个师生框架. 对于有多个扫描(如不同时间点或对比阶段)的患者,我们每一次扫描运行一个师生实例(共享权重). 每个学生都独立扫描一次 教师通过图像间交叉交流信息,并接受额外扫描一致性损失的培训。 (b) 师生蒸馏。 教师利用来自多幅图像和报告的信息,创建高质量的肿瘤分解口罩. 学生只看到一个形象,但用老师创造的高质量面具来训练. 推论,当往往无法获得多个图像和报告时,我们只使用学生. (c) 了解报告变压器。 教师有一台变压器,通过交叉注意接收纵向图像的信息和报告. 它利用这种信息来创造进化内核,它精炼学生的特征,以制造一个改进的,报告和纵向的,有知觉的肿瘤面具. 由于老师通过完善学生的特征来创造这个面具,学生是老师的一部分.

blocks.en: 2 RT-Super
blocks.zh: 2个RT-超级

blocks.en: RT-Super is based on a new self-distillation architecture. The student is a standard segmentation model, of any architecture (here, MedFormer [ 12 ] ). It receives a single image (no report) and segments tumors. The teacher is a hybrid between transformers and convolutional networks. It receives information from radiology reports, longitudinal images, and multi-phase images. The teacher exploits this information to refine the deep features of the student, creating an improved tumor segmentation mask. This mask is used to train the student in the absence of ground-truth tumor masks. The RT-Super architecture is shown in Fig. 1 , and explained in Sec. 2.1 . To better exploit consistencies across multi-phase and longitudinal images, we introduce Consistency Losses. Before training RT-Super, we use a large language model (LLM) to extract relevant tumor information from reports, including tumor count, locations (organs), and diameters [ 1 ] . The LLM runs only once. We use the Llama 3.1 70B AWQ LLM, which was shown to extract tumor information from reports with 96% accuracy [ 3 ] .
blocks.zh: RT-Super基于一个新的自我消化架构. 学生是任何建筑的标准分割模型(这里, MedFormer [12]. 它得到一个单一的图像(没有报告)和片段肿瘤. 教师是变压器和革命网络的混合体. 它从放射学报告、纵向图像和多相图像中获得信息。 老师利用这些信息来细化学生的深层特征,创造了一个更好的肿瘤分化面具. 这种面具用于在没有地面真肿瘤面具的情况下训练学生. RT-Super架构在图1中显示,并在第2.1节中解释. 为了更好地利用多阶段和纵向图像的成分,我们引入一致性损失。 在训练RT-Super之前,我们使用大型语言模型(LLM)从报告中提取相关的肿瘤信息,包括肿瘤计数,位置(器官),直径[1]. LLM只运行过一次. 我们使用Llama 3.1 70B AWQ LLM,它显示从报告中提取肿瘤信息,准确度为96%[3].

blocks.en: 2.1 RT-Super Architecture
blocks.zh: 2.1 RT-超级建筑

blocks.en: RT-Super uses a self-distillation, teacher-student architecture, where the student is the initial part of the teacher network (Fig. 1 ). Any segmentation architecture can be used as the student (we used MedFormer [ 12 ] ). The student receives one image and creates its tumor mask. The teacher improves this mask by leveraging information from reports and from longitudinal images. The teacher has a convolutional path and a report-aware transformer . The convolutional path refines the deep features of the student with a sequence of convolutional layers. The kernels of these layers are created by the report-aware transformer, which has access to the student’s deep features, and to information from radiology reports and multiple images. Thus, the transformer creates convolutional kernels that iteratively refine the student’s features, finally creating a tumor mask that better matches reports and is more consistent with longitudinal and multi-phase images. This mask is the teacher’s output.
blocks.zh: RT-Super使用自沉式,师生建筑,其中学生是教师网络的初始部分(图1). 任何分区结构都可以作为学生使用(我们使用了MedFormer[12]. 学生得到一个图像并产生肿瘤面具. 教师通过利用报告和纵向图像的信息来改进这一面具。 老师有一条革命之路 和了解报告的变压器。 革命之路用一系列的革命层来细化学生的深刻特征. 这些层的内核是由能接触到学生深层特征的报告-意识变压器,以及从放射学报告和多幅图像中获取的信息所创造的. 因此,变压器会产生递增的内核,迭代地完善学生的特征,最终形成一个肿瘤面具,更好地匹配报告,更符合纵向和多相图像. 这个面具是老师的输出.

blocks.en: The teacher’s convolutional path is a sequence of convolutional blocks, one for each resolution level in the student decoder. The teacher’s convolutional block k refines the student decoder features at level k, S k S_{k} . Specifically, the input of the teacher convolutional block k is S k S_{k} , concatenated with T k − 1 T_{k-1} , the output of the teacher’s previous convolutional block (up-sampled). Each convolutional block applies a 3 × 3 × 3 3\times 3\times 3 convolution followed by a 1 × 1 × 1 1\times 1\times 1 convolution (each with instance normalization and leaky ReLU). Crucially, the kernels of these two convolutions are produced by the teacher’s report-aware transformer. After the teacher’s final convolutional block, a 1 × 1 × 1 1\times 1\times 1 convolution (transformer-generated) maps the final refined features to a tumor segmentation map (teacher’s output).

blocks.en:
The teacher’s report-aware transformer (Fig. 1 ) starts from learnable queries. These queries are updated by transformer blocks, encoding information from reports and longitudinal/multi-phase images (explained later). Then, the updated queries are used to create convolutional kernels. In transformer block k, a report cross-attention layer updates the queries with cross-attention to tumor attributes extracted from reports (keys/values) 2 2 2 Attributes: tumor diameter, organ, slice (tumor z coordinate), attenuation (hyper-/hypo-/iso-attenuating), and malignancy. Attributes are encoded numerically. . Afterwards, a feature cross-attention layer updates the queries with cross-attention to the input of convolutional block k (which includes deep features from the student), followed by standard multi-head self-attention and a multi-layer perceptron (MLP). Updated queries at the output of transformer block k are used to create kernels for the convolutional block k. For the 1 × 1 × 1 1\times 1\times 1 convolution, an MLP directly creates the convolutional kernel from multiple queries. For the 3 × 3 × 3 3\times 3\times 3 convolution, directly generating its kernel would be expensive.
So, we use an approach inspired by soft mixture of experts and Dynamic Convolutions [ 9 ] : the transformer chooses which 3 × 3 × 3 3\times 3\times 3 kernel to use, from a learnable bank of M M candidate kernels (we use M = 16 M=16 ). An MLP with softmax activation takes one query from the output of the transformer block k, and predicts mixture weights for this bank. The final 3 × 3 × 3 3\times 3\times 3 kernel is then computed as the weighted linear combination of the M M kernels in the bank.
blocks.zh:
教师的报告意识转换器(图1)从可学习的询问开始。 这些查询是通过变压器块、报告提供的编码信息和纵向/多相图像(稍后解释)更新的。 之后,更新的查询被用于创建革命内核. 在变压器区块k中,报告交叉注意层对从报告(键/值)中提取的肿瘤属性进行交叉注意更新,2 2 属性:肿瘤直径、器官、切片(肿瘤z坐标)、衰减(湿/湿/异激)和恶性。 属性以数字编码. 之后,一个特性交叉关注层以交叉关注的方式更新了对进化块k(包括学生的深层特征)的输入的询问,然后是标准多头自我关注和多层感知(MLP). 变压器块k输出时更新的查询用于为变压器块k创建内核. 对于1×1×1\1\1\1\1 con1 con1volution1volution1volution,MLP直接通过多个查询生成了volution1volution1 1 . 对于3×3×3\3\3\3\3\3volution3volution3volution3 con3 con,直接生成其内核会很昂贵.
因此,我们采用了一种由专家与动态革命的软组合所启发的方法: 变压器从一个可学习的M M候选内核库(我们使用M=16 M=16)中选择使用哪一个 3× 3× 3 3\times 3\times 3内核. 软max激活的MLP对变压器块k的输出进行一个查询,并预测这个库的混合物重量. 最终的 3× 3× 3× 3× 3× 3× 3× 3 内核随后被计算为银行中MM内核的加权线性组合.

blocks.en: The transformer blocks are connected sequentially. Each block k updates its input queries. Some of its output queries are used to create the convolutional kernels for the convolutional block k k ; the others are given to the next transformer block, k + 1 k+1 . A special transformer block is placed before all kernel-generating blocks. It updates all learnable queries and forwards them to the subsequent blocks. In this update, the block performs cross-attention between the queries and three concatenated segmentation masks: the student’s output, a mask for the organ with tumors, and a mask for the tumor slices. The tumor slices and the organs with tumors are defined by the report, and the corresponding organ masks are created before training 3 3 3 We used nnU-Net [ 16 ] trained for organ segmentation on AbdomenAtlas [ 19 ] . Public AI models [ 2 , 25 ] can create masks for multiple organs, but not their tumors. We use 2 cm of binary dilation to compensate for mask errors. . These masks spatially inform the report-aware transformer where the student thinks the tumor is, and where the tumor should actually be, according to the report.
blocks.zh: 变压器块依次连接. 每个块 k 更新其输入查询. 其部分输出查询用于为转录区块k k 创建转录内核;其他则给予下一个变压器块k + 1 k+1. 在所有内核生成区块之前放置一个特殊的变压器块. 它更新所有可学习的查询,并将其转发到之后的块. 在这个更新中,该块在询问和三个切片口罩之间进行交叉注意:学生的输出、带肿瘤的器官的口罩和肿瘤切片的口罩。 肿瘤切片和有肿瘤的器官是由报告定义的,相应的器官口罩是在训练3 3 3 之前创建的,我们使用 nnU-Net [16] 在 AbdomenAtlas [19] 上接受器官分解训练. 公共AI模型[2,25]可以为多个器官制造口罩,但不能为它们的肿瘤. 我们用2厘米的二进制缩写来弥补面具的错误... 根据报告,这些面具在空间上告知了学生认为肿瘤所在的、以及肿瘤实际所在的视窗。

blocks.en: When longitudinal or multi-phase images are available for a patient, we run one teacher-student instance per image (shared weights). Each student instance processes only its own image. In contrast, the teacher instances communicate through cross-attention. Specifically, in each teacher transformer block k, we add an inter-image cross-attention layer after the report cross-attention (Fig. 1 ). This layer updates the current instance’s learnable queries by attending to the other teacher instances—to the input features of the convolutional block k in each other teacher instance.
blocks.zh: 当患者可以获得纵向或多相图像时,我们每个图像运行一个师生实例(共享权重). 每个学生案例只处理自己的形象. 相比之下,教师案例通过交叉关注进行沟通。 具体地说,在每个师资变压器k块中,我们都会在报告交叉注意后增加一个图像交叉注意层(图1)。 这一层更新了当前实例中可学习的询问, 方法是关注其他教师实例,

blocks.en: We also inform the teacher about the date for each image and its contrast phase, with new tokens in the report cross-attention. Thus, when generating convolutional kernels, each teacher instance can leverage reports together with information from longitudinal and multi-phase images. RT-Super handles missing data. When report attributes or longitudinal images are missing, we set them to zero in the report cross-attention. As RT-Super targets both tumor segmentation and detection, we add a classifier on top of the teacher and student segmentation outputs. It is trained jointly with the segmenter.
blocks.zh: 我们还向教师通报每个图像的日期及其对比阶段,报告中有新的标志。 因此,在生成演化内核时,每个师范实例都可以利用报告以及纵向和多阶段图像的信息。 RT-Super处理缺失数据. 当缺少报告属性或纵向图像时,我们在报告中将其设定为零。 由于RT-Super既针对肿瘤分化,也针对检测,所以在师生分化产出之上,我们增加了一个分类器. 它与分机一起训练。

blocks.en: 2.2 RT-Super Loss Functions
blocks.zh: 2.2 RT-超损失函数

blocks.en: For images that have ground-truth tumor masks, we directly use these masks to train the teacher and the student, using the usual Dice and binary cross-entropy (BCE) losses. For images without masks, we train the teacher with Report Supervision losses [ 4 ] . The Volume Loss teaches the teacher to segment tumors matching the tumor volume and locations (organs) estimated from reports. The Ball Loss makes the segmented tumors match reports in terms of tumor diameter, count, and locations.
blocks.zh: 对于有地面真肿瘤口罩的图像,我们直接使用这些口罩来训练老师和学生,使用通常的Dice和二进制交叉(BCE)损失. 对于没有面具的图像,我们用报告监督损失来训练老师[4]. " 体积损失 " 教教师将肿瘤与报告估计的肿瘤体积和位置(器官)相匹配。 Ball Loss使得分块肿瘤在肿瘤直径,计数和位置方面匹配报告.

blocks.en: For images without masks, we train the student with distillation: Dice and BCE losses encourage the student’s output to match the teacher’s output. We do distillation with hard targets, created by binarizing the teacher’s tumor segmentation output with report-based post-processing (Ball Loss pseudo-mask [ 1 ] ). 4 4 4 This post-processing refines a soft mask into a binary mask that better matches the tumor size, count, and location in reports. Through distillation, a student that sees a single image and no report can learn from high-quality masks created by a teacher that exploits privileged information—longitudinal images, multi-phase images, and their reports.
blocks.zh: 对于没有面具的图像,我们训练学生进行蒸馏: Dice和BCE损失鼓励学生的产量与老师的产量相匹配. 我们用硬目标进行蒸馏,通过将老师的肿瘤分解输出与基于报告后处理的二元化(Ball Loss preathe-mask [1])来创造。 4 4 4 此处理后将软面罩精炼成二进制面罩,更好地匹配肿瘤大小,计数,以及报告位置. 通过蒸馏,一个看到单一图像而没有任何报告的学生无法从教师利用特权信息——纵向图像、多阶段图像及其报告——创造的高质量面具中学习。

blocks.en: We also propose a Consistency Loss that lets the teacher use longitudinal images with larger, clearer tumors to guide segmentation in scans where tumors are smaller and unclear. As tumors can grow over time or shrink with treatment, we enforce location consistency : tumors segmented in a “small-tumor” scan S should lie inside the corresponding tumors in a “large-tumor” scan L (plus a conservative margin). We apply the Consistency Loss when the radiology report indicates that all tumors in scan S are smaller than all tumors in scan L. (1) Registration. We register scan L to S using uniGradICON [ 24 ] , which predicts a deformation field based on images and organ masks 5 5 5 We fine-tune uniGradICON during segmentation training. If registration fails (Dice similarity coefficient, DSC, < 0.8 <0.8 between registered and target organ masks), we skip the Consistency Loss. . With the deformation field, we register the teacher’s output tumor mask, made for scan L, to the space of S. The teacher’s output tumor mask is binarized with report-based post-processing before registration, improving the agreement between the tumor mask and the report. We dilate the registered tumor mask by 2 cm to compensate for registration errors. (2) Consistency. We enforce that tumors segmented in scan S lie inside the registered and dilated tumor mask of scan L by modifying the Volume Loss and Ball Loss [ 1 ] . Originally, these losses encourage segmented tumors to lie inside the organ where the report mentions tumors, localized with a precomputed organ mask. Here, we replace that organ mask with its intersection with the registered (and dilated) tumor mask from L, and then apply the Ball and Volume losses on S.
blocks.zh: 我们还提出一个一致性损失,让老师使用具有更大,更清晰肿瘤的纵向图像,在肿瘤较小且不明确的扫描中引导分化. 由于肿瘤可以随时间推移而生长或随治疗而收缩,我们实施位置一致性:在“小肿瘤”扫描S中分解的肿瘤应该在“大肿瘤”扫描L(加上保守的边距)中位于相应的肿瘤内。 当放射学报告显示扫描S中的所有肿瘤都比扫描L(1)中的所有肿瘤小时,我们应用一致性损失. 我们使用uniGradICON [24] 进行L到S的扫描,它根据图像和器官口罩预测变形场 5 5 5 我们在分区训练中微调uniGradICON. 如果注册失败(Dice相似性系数,DSC, < 0.8 < 0.8在注册器官口罩与目标器官口罩之间),我们跳过一致性损失。 在变形场上,我们将教师的输出肿瘤口罩登记在S的空间内。 教师的输出肿瘤面具在注册前用基于报告的后处理二进制,改善了肿瘤面具与报告之间的协议. 我们把注册的肿瘤面具放大2厘米 以弥补注册错误 (2)一致性。 我们通过修改卷损和球损[1] 来强制将扫描中分解的肿瘤放在扫描L的注册和放大肿瘤面具内。 最初,这些损失会鼓励分裂的肿瘤躺在报告提到肿瘤的器官内,用预编造的器官面具局部化. 在这里,我们用它与来自L的注册(和膨胀)肿瘤面具的交汇点来替换这个器官面具,然后在S上应用Ball和Volume损失.

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: Table 1: Trained with longitudinal and multi-phase images and reports, RT-Super improves multi-tumor detection with a single image and no report at inference (internal test). RT-Super surpasses previous public AI models and alternative training methods. The main gain over R-Super is when training without masks. This dataset includes malignant tumors and control (no-tumor) cases. Sensitivity (Se), specificity (Sp), and F1 at the operating point maximizing balanced accuracy for each model. † : trained with reports only (no tumor masks). Bold: best within each group.
blocks.zh: 表1:经过纵向和多相图像和报告训练,RT-Super改进了多图束检测,采用单一图像,没有推断报告(内部测试)。 RT-Super超越了之前的公共AI模式和替代培训方法. 优于R-Super的主要收益在于没有面具的训练. 该数据集包括恶性肿瘤和控制(无肿瘤)病例. 敏感度(Se),特异性(Sp),以及操作点的F1,使每个模型的平衡精确度最大化. ^ :只接受报告训练(没有肿瘤口罩). 粗体:每组内最好.

blocks.en: Table 2: External validation on small tumors and ablations. We test RT-Super on data from an unseen hospital. Trained with reports only, RT-Super substantially surpasses R-Super in segmentation DSC. Detection (Se, Sp, and area under the ROC curve, AUC) is evaluated on small tumors ( < < 2 cm) only; DSC on masks (35% small). DSC is lower for these tumor types than for others such as pancreatic tumors [ 20 ] , because these tumor types are harder to segment on CT, which is not their primary imaging modality. Reflecting this difficulty, the DSC between masks created by two radiologists (2 and 8 years of experience) in our test set was 66, 50, and 62 for spleen, esophagus, and uterus tumors, respectively. Sensitivity and specificity at the operating point maximizing balanced accuracy for each model. † : trained with reports only (no tumor masks). Bold: best within each group (ablation rows excluded).
blocks.zh: 表2:关于小肿瘤和脓肿的外部鉴定。 我们通过一个隐形医院的数据测试RT -Super. RT-Super只接受过报告培训,在DSC分化方面大大超过了R-Super. 检测(Se, Sp,以及ROC曲线下的区域,AUC)只在小肿瘤( < 2 cm)上评价;戴口罩的DSC(小35%)上评价. 这些肿瘤类型的DSC比胰腺瘤[20]等其他类型的DSC要低,因为这些肿瘤类型在CT上更难分辨,而CT并不是它们的主要成像模式. 反映这一困难的是,我们测试组中两名放射学家(2年和8年的经验)创造的口罩之间的DSC分别为66,50和62,分别是脾脏,食道,子宫肿瘤. 操作点的敏感性和特异性使每个模型的平衡准确度最大化。 粗体:在每个组内最好(不包括缩略行).

blocks.en: Datasets. (1) Training: 34,152 CT-Report pairs, from 10,385 control patients (10.4% with longitudinal CTs, 3.8% multi-phase), 7,597 spleen tumor patients (33.2% longitudinal, 11.9% multi-phase), 4,258 uterus tumor patients (23.7% longitudinal, 8.8% multi-phase), and 741 esophagus tumor patients (28.7% longitudinal, 21.3% multi-phase). The training set includes 767 tumor masks (238 spleen, 288 uterus, 241 esophagus). All data were collected from the UCSF hospital and affiliated institutions across California. Longitudinal and multi-phase CT scans are part of the full dataset, and all models were trained with the full dataset. (2) Internal Test (pathology-proven): CT-Report pairs from patients with pathology-proven malignant tumors from UCSF, plus random controls—148 no-tumor CTs, 34 spleen tumor CTs, 235 esophagus tumor CTs, and 84 uterus tumor CTs. (3) External Test (small tumors): CT-Report pairs from an unseen hospital (Istanbul Medipol University, Turkey). Positive scans: spleen 135, esophagus 45, uterus 12; 226 controls. It includes benign and malignant tumors, all small ( ≤ \leq 2 cm in diameter). (4) External Test (masks): used for DSC calculation, CT-Mask pairs from the same external hospital, spleen 25, esophagus 17, uterus 13. It includes benign and malignant tumors, 35% of them small. In testing, AI models have no access to patient reports or to longitudinal images.
blocks.zh: 数据集. (1) 培训:34 152对CT-报告对,包括10 385名控制病人(10.4%为纵向CT,3.8%为多相)、7 597名脾肿瘤病人(33.2%为纵向,11.9%)、4 258名子宫肿瘤病人(23.7%为纵向,8.8%为多相)和741名食道肿瘤病人(28.7%为纵向,21.3%)。 该训练集包括767个肿瘤口罩(238个脾脏,288个子宫,241个食道). 所有数据都是从加州大学附属医院和附属机构收集的。 纵向和多相CT扫描是完整数据集的一部分,所有模型都接受了完整数据集的培训. (2) 内部试验(病理学证明): 病理学-经UCSF证明的恶性肿瘤患者的CT-报告对,加上随机控制——148无肿瘤CTs,34脾肿瘤CTs,235食道肿瘤CTs,84子宫肿瘤CTs. (3) 外部试验(小肿瘤):CT-报告对不见医院(土耳其伊斯坦布尔梅迪波尔大学)。 正扫描:脾135,食道45,子宫12;226控制. 它包括良性肿瘤和恶性肿瘤,都很小(直径为 \\leq 2 cm). (4)外部试验(masks):用于DSC计算,同一外部医院的CT-mask对,脾脏25,食道17,子宫13. 它包括良性肿瘤和恶性肿瘤,其中35%是小的. 在测试中,AI模型无法获取患者报告或纵向图像.

blocks.en: Training RT-Super. We trained two variants: RT-Super † using CT-Report pairs, and RT-Super using CT-Report and CT-Mask pairs. We used MedFormer [ 12 ] as the student, and used its training hyperparameters for RT-Super and all MedFormer-based baselines—segmentation, CLIP, Models Genesis, MTL, R-Super, and classification (MedFormer’s encoder). We used the R-Super cropping strategy [ 1 ] . Loss weights were 1 for supervised segmentation losses and distillation, and 0.1 for Consistency and Report Supervision losses. By the end of training, the RT-Super teacher surpassed its student by 2.9% DSC. nnU-Net [ 16 ] was trained out of the box (ResEncL architecture), but with 1 mm spacing. Models Genesis and CLIP were pre-trained on all CTs and on all CT-Report pairs, respectively, and then fine-tuned on all CT-Mask pairs. MTL was trained jointly on all CT-Report and CT-Mask pairs. Classification was trained on all CTs, with tumor presence/absence labels (per organ) from reports. Segmentation (MedFormer) and nnU-Net were only trained on CT-Mask pairs. ULS, Merlin, and MedGemma used their public checkpoints.
blocks.zh: 培训RT-Super. 我们训练了两种变种:使用CT-报告对的RT-Super †,使用CT-报告对的RT-Super和CT-mask对的RT-Super. 我们用MedFormer[12]作为学生,并用其训练超参数进行RT-Super和所有基于MedFormer的基线——分号、CLIP、模型创世纪、MTL、R-Super和分类(MedFormer的编码器)。 我们用的是R型超级作物种植策略 [1]. 损失重量为1,用于监督分解损失和蒸馏,0.1用于一致性和报告监督损失。 在培训结束时,RT-Super的老师以2.9%的DSC超过了学生. nnU-Net [16]被训练出盒子(ResEncL架构),但间隔1毫米. Models Genesis和CLIP分别对所有CT和所有CT-Report配对进行预训,然后对所有CT-Mask配对进行微调. MTL在所有CT-Report和CT-Mask对子上接受了联合培训. 对所有CT进行了分类培训,从报告中列出肿瘤存在/缺失标签(每个器官)。 分片(MedFormer)和nnU-Net只接受了CT-mask对片的培训. ULS,梅林和MedGemma都使用了他们的公共检查站.

blocks.en: RT-Super surpasses prior public AI in detecting esophagus, spleen and uterus tumors (Tab. 1 and 2 ). RT-Super substantially surpasses Merlin, MedGemma, and ULS, three leading public AI models. Merlin and MedGemma are VLMs. They generated reports and we evaluated these reports for tumor detection (following [ 3 ] ). The VLM reports had low sensitivity, missing the tumor types we analyzed here. VLMs were surpassed by segmentation models, as in [ 3 , 10 ] . Here, VLM performance was even lower than in [ 3 ] , because our tumor types are rarer and more difficult to detect on CT. ULS surpassed VLMs, but still had low sensitivity, likely because our tumor types are rare or absent in its training data. Also, ULS is trained on tumor crops only, which puts it at a disadvantage in tumor detection. RT-Super surpassed all the public AI models.
blocks.zh: 在检测食道、脾脏和子宫肿瘤方面,RT-Super超过了以前的公共AI(第1和第2段)。 RT-Super大大超越了Merlin,MedGemma,以及ULS,三大公共AI模型. 梅林和MedGemma是VLMs. 他们生成了报告,我们评价了这些报告以检测肿瘤(随后是[3])。 VLM报告灵敏度低, 错过了我们分析过的肿瘤类型。 如[3,10]中那样,VLM被分区模型超越. 这里,VLM的性能甚至比[3]还要低,因为我们的肿瘤类型更罕见,更难在CT上检测. ULS超过了VLM,但仍具有较低的灵敏度,可能是因为我们的肿瘤类型很少或在其训练数据中缺失. 另外,ULS只接受肿瘤作物的培训,这使得其在肿瘤检测中处于劣势. RT-Super超越了所有公共AI模式.

blocks.en: RT-Super improves tumor detection and segmentation with few or no tumor masks. Tab. 1 shows that RT-Super surpassed 8 other training methods that also trained on our dataset, but were not designed to jointly leverage reports, longitudinal images, and multi-phase images. Although RT-Super performed similarly to R-Super in tumor detection, it substantially surpassed R-Super in segmentation DSC when training without masks (Tab. 2 ). Tab. 2 displays diverse ablation studies, showing how each component of RT-Super improves performance.
blocks.zh: RT-Super改进肿瘤检测和分解,很少或没有肿瘤口罩. 标签1显示,RT-Super超过了其他8种培训方法,这些方法也培训了我们的数据集,但并非旨在联合利用报告、纵向图像和多相图像。 虽然RT-Super在肿瘤检测中的表现与R-Super相似,但在没有口罩的训练中却大大超过了R-Super在分化DSC(Tab. 2 ). Tab. 2展示了多种膨胀研究,显示了RT-Super的每个组件如何提高性能.

blocks.en: Conclusion. Tumor mask creation is expensive and time-consuming, leaving public datasets and segmentation models unable to cover most tumor types. Following R-Super [ 1 , 4 ] , RT-Super shows that AI can learn tumor segmentation from routinely available hospital data (reports, longitudinal images, and multi-phase images) rather than from manual masks. This can scale tumor segmentation to more tumor types.
blocks.zh: 结论。 肿瘤口罩的创造成本昂贵且耗时,使得公共数据集和分块模型无法覆盖大多数肿瘤类型. 在R-Super [1, 4]之后,RT-Super显示AI可以从常规可获得的医院数据(报告,纵向图像,以及多相图像)中而不是从手动口罩中学习肿瘤分化. 这可以把肿瘤的分化扩大至更多的肿瘤类型.
